name: garage-evening-autolock
goal: After sunset, re-lock the garage entry door once unlocked past the timeout, behind a dashboard switch, with a warning push, snooze and lockout guards.

userStories.title: Spike: confirm the outdoor guards are real signals
userStories.description: Read-only recorder and state reads on the host for the driveway, back yard and garage sensors.
acceptanceCriteria: Back yard entity ids are confirmed from live state and listed in pre-mortem.md
Each guard sensor has on-transitions in the last 14 days and no run longer than 20 minutes

userStories.title: Evening auto lock automation and helpers
userStories.description: packages/mudroom/garage_entry_door/garage_entry_door_evening_auto_lock.yaml with the switch, snooze timer and unlock-window timer.
acceptanceCriteria: Conditions: switch, guest/entertainment, emergency, notification level, sun below_horizon, time after 12:00, lock and door for the timeout, just arrived, snooze idle, all outdoor guards for 5 minutes, cover closed
Warn (time-sensitive, snooze), wait 2 minutes, snooze stops, recheck, lock with continue_on_error, locked-or-failed push
No start or reload trigger; sunset offset 1 minute

userStories.title: Unlock action handler
userStories.description: Standalone event automation for the Unlock tap on the Locked push.
acceptanceCriteria: Needs unlock-window timer active, lock locked, house occupied, bedtime off
Cancels the window after one unlock

userStories.title: Dashboard switch and README
userStories.description: Add the switch and shared timeout to the garage entry lock popup; README line.
acceptanceCriteria: Popup has input_boolean.garage_entry_door_evening_auto_lock and the timeout row when on

userStories.title: Regression tests with sabotage checks
acceptanceCriteria: Each gate, guard, daytime and morning case blocks
Trigger set, recheck parity, push priorities, unlock handler pinned
Full suite passes; sabotage checks go red

userStories.title: Docs, LEARNINGS and memory
userStories.description: docs/AUTOMATIONS.md, packages/mudroom/LEARNINGS.md, memory entry and index.
acceptanceCriteria: Each is updated in this branch
